# Peter Skaronis

> Personal site of Peter Skaronis — cybersecurity consultant, vCISO, and founder of Techimpossible. Essays on security, compliance and the constraints people do not notice, plus the tools and games he builds.

Peter Skaronis is a Cybersecurity Consultant & vCISO based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, originally from Greece, and the founder of Techimpossible. He works on Cybersecurity, Virtual CISO (vCISO), SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA. Contact: peter.skaronis@techimpossible.com.

## Techimpossible

Cybersecurity and compliance consultancy for growing companies. Audit readiness, security programs that survive contact with a real auditor, and governance for teams shipping AI.

Website: https://techimpossible.com. Area served: Canada, United States, remote worldwide.

- **SOC 2 readiness and audit support**: Get to a SOC 2 report without stalling engineering: scoping, control design, evidence, and support through the external audit.
- **ISO 27001 and ISO 42001**: Build an ISMS that passes certification and stays useful afterwards, including AI management systems under ISO 42001.
- **HIPAA compliance**: Safeguards, risk analysis and documentation for teams handling protected health information.
- **Virtual CISO (vCISO)**: Fractional security leadership: strategy, risk decisions, customer security reviews and board-level reporting.
- **AI governance and security**: Policy, risk assessment and controls for companies building with or buying AI, mapped to recognised frameworks.
- **Vendor and third-party risk**: Assess suppliers properly, and answer your own customers' security questionnaires without derailing a quarter.

## Writing

- [Essays](https://blog.skaronis.com): Long-form writing on invisible constraints — geographic, economic and psychological — drawn from lived experience rather than advice.
- [Cybersecurity Notes](https://notes.techimpossible.com): Technical notes on security practice, frameworks and compliance.
- [Archive](https://skaronis.com/archive): Every post, grouped by year and month.

## Projects

- [LifeLens](https://lifelens.skaronis.com): A life reflection and planning tool built around the observation that a life is roughly four thousand weeks. Privacy-first: everything stays in your browser.
- [ThinkLens](https://thinklens.pages.dev/): A thinking tool that applies structured mental models to a decision you are actually facing.
- [Cybersecurity Basics](https://cybersecuritybasics.ca/): A free interactive assessment and course teaching cybersecurity fundamentals to people who are not security professionals.
- [Claude Skills](https://skaronis.com/claude-skills): An open library of Claude Code skills, including a security posture check and the Techimpossible security advisory format.
- [Veridis Quo](https://skaronis.com/veridis-quo): A retro arcade game — a neon odyssey, built for the pleasure of building it.
- [33 Σκαλιά \(33 Steps\)](https://skaronis.com/mazo): A fan tribute to Giorgos Mazonakis, 1972 to 2026: a climb through 33 of his songs as oil paintings, from the dark to the light.
- [GRC Refinement](https://refinement.techimpossible.com/): A game that teaches governance, risk and compliance estimation by making you do it.
- [Life of a Cybersecurity Consultant](https://skaronis.com/cyber): A narrative game about the actual day-to-day of consulting in security.
- [Digital Awareness](https://skaronis.com/awareness): A live demonstration of what a website can infer about you before you have typed anything.
- [Autofill Security](https://skaronis.com/autofill): Shows how hidden form fields can harvest far more than the data you thought you were giving away.
- [Photography](https://unsplash.com/@skaronis): Landscape photography, released free on Unsplash.
